# Legacy sound fixtures

Captured from production commit `0be3ed7f65ac84bdb58abf5ed425f3f712efcb8b`
before changing the parameter table or DSP. Each state contains the original
nine parameter IDs. `legacy-0` is Live and `legacy-1` is Mix TP prototype.

The corresponding `.f64` file contains 2048 interleaved stereo frames, little
endian doubles, at 48 kHz. Input is generated by the legacy compatibility test.
The fixture includes non-default Input, Ceiling, Release, Transient, Lookahead,
Comparison Trim and Guide values. The tail and fixed 288-sample delay are included.

These are audio regression fixtures, not UI demonstrations or recorded native
interaction evidence.

Capture compiler: Apple clang, `-std=c++17 -O3 -DNDEBUG -arch arm64
-mmacosx-version-min=11.0`, matching the Release test target. The originally
captured -O2 Mix fixture differed by at most 1.11e-16 under -O3. The checked-in
fixture was regenerated from the exact 0be3 source with the Release flags; it
was not regenerated from the changed DSP. `CaptureBaseline.cpp` is the capture
program and must be built against the original source snapshot.
